summary: The filing is an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 by News Corporation, reporting routine disclosures made to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding the company's ongoing share repurchase program. The repurchase program authorizes up to $1 billion aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock. No specific transactions, price, premium, or terms are provided; the filing merely states the company will continue repurchasing from time to time and attaches ASX disclosure exhibits. This is a routine capital return disclosure, not a special-situation event. There is no event that would attract risk-arb or represent a meaningful change; it is simply compliance with ASX disclosure rules.
